facts.fact: MoHCC Permanent Secretary Dr Maunganidze told HealthTimes that 1,197 health facilities have been equipped with the Impilo EHR since 2021, against a 1,322 target (all facilities, not primary clinics alone).
The Ministry of Health and Child Care's Permanent Secretary describes Impilo as an integrated national health record system the ministry is rolling out.
